表示某地有某物（过去式）
There were twenty cars in the race.

grammar.f: There was/were + 名词 + 地点/时间
grammar.d: There be句型用于表示某地存在某人或某物，过去式分别用There was（单数）和There were（复数） 描述过去某处存在的人或物，注意there was后接单数名词，there were后接复数名词
ex: There was a very big race in 1995.
There were twenty cars in the race.
There were hundreds of people there.

grammar.f: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.d: 表示过去某一时间发生的动作或存在的状态，动词用过去式 描述过去发生的事情，常见的过去式变化包括：规则动词加-ed，不规则动词需单独记忆
ex: My wife and I were at the race.
She said to me, 'Don't drive so quickly!'

grammar.f: on the left / on the right
grammar.d: 表示在某物的左边或右边 用于描述位置，常与standing、sitting等动词连用
ex: We are standing on the left.
The shop is on the right side of the street.

patterns.p: There was/were + 数量词 + 名词...
o: There were twenty cars in the race.
im: There was a big supermarket near our house.
我们家附近有一家大超市。
There were fifty students in the classroom.

o: Our friends Julie and Jack were there, too.
我们的朋友Julie和Jack也在那里。
im: I was at the cinema yesterday.
They were at the party last night.
